description: This file contains a custom implementation of a Spark Streaming Receiver for Amazon Kinesis, utilizing the Kinesis Client Library (KCL). It manages data ingestion from Kinesis streams, including starting/stopping the scheduler, handling data blocks, checkpointing, and processing Kinesis records.

classes.name: KinesisReceiver
classes.description: A custom Spark Streaming Receiver for Amazon Kinesis streams, managing data ingestion, checkpointing, and block generation using the Kinesis Client Library.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Initializes the Kinesis scheduler, block generator, and thread to start data processing.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Shuts down the scheduler and cleans up resources when the receiver stops.

methods.name: addRecords
methods.description: Adds a batch of Kinesis records from a shard to the current data block.

methods.name: getCurrentLimit
methods.description: Returns the current rate limit for data ingestion.

methods.name: getLatestSeqNumToCheckpoint
methods.description: Retrieves the latest sequence number that can be checkpointed for a shard.

methods.name: setCheckpointer
methods.description: Sets the checkpointer for a specific shard.

methods.name: removeCheckpointer
methods.description: Removes the checkpointer for a specific shard.

methods.name: rememberAddedRange
methods.description: Records the sequence number range added to the current block.

methods.name: finalizeRangesForCurrentBlock
methods.description: Finalizes and stores the sequence number ranges for a completed block.

methods.name: storeBlockWithRanges
methods.description: Stores a completed data block along with its sequence number ranges and updates checkpoint info.
